scenario_description:
Objective: Finish recording TriRiver Mobility’s operator-dashboard refresher segment for tomorrow’s training packet.
Emerging Need: The studio session is scheduled, opened, and recording begins, then the same active take stops with the booth console locked in assist mode.
Decision Context: Observable updates separate normal recording progress from a recoverable equipment hold; the authorized reset path is kept only in internal account/contact records.
Consequence: If the locked take is not cleared while its autosave remains live, the partial recording is discarded and the training packet loses its prepared walkthrough segment.

parameter.title: TriRiver refresher recording block
parameter.description: Record the operator-dashboard refresher walkthrough for tomorrow's client training packet; export target before 14:30.

parameter.content: Starting the TriRiver refresher recording in Studio 3 now. Slide deck and headset are loaded; aiming to finish the walkthrough in one take before the export window.

parameter.subject: Studio 3 session TRIR-REFRESH-0222 is recording
parameter.body: Studio 3 session TRIR-REFRESH-0222 has begun recording. Autosave is active and the current take can be resumed from the console if recording is interrupted before the session closes.

parameter.content: Recording stopped mid-walkthrough. The Studio 3 console shows: Assist Mode Lock — active take paused, local controls disabled, do not power cycle, autosave recoverable until 13:45.

parameter.subject: Studio 3 session TRIR-REFRESH-0222 autosave closed
parameter.body: The paused take for session TRIR-REFRESH-0222 was not resumed before the autosave recovery cutoff. The partial recording has been discarded; a new recording session is required for export. Studio 3 is now committed to the next recording; a new full take cannot be booked before today’s 14:30 export.
